# apipbx_misc_destination (Resource)

A number (internal, or external through the outbound routes) that can be a destination. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `number` (String) 2-20 characters from 0-9 * #.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
